# Status: <name>

## Lifecycle status

Proposed | Approved | In development | Implemented | Verified | Released

## Current phase

Which phase of `plan.md`, when there is one.

## Current task

## Completed

## Next action

The single next thing, specific enough that a new session can start on it without asking.

## Open decisions

Anything awaiting a founder decision, and what is blocked by each. Empty when nothing is pending —
never absent.

## Blocked

## Risks

Known risks and assumptions not yet validated. Distinct from Blocked: a risk is something that may
cost later, not something stopping work now.

## Validation

What was actually run, with the output and counts read. State unrun checks plainly.

## Specification impact

What this changed in the spec, or "none".

## Documentation impact

Which authoritative documents now disagree with the code, and whether they were updated.
